steps.title: Start a new round
steps.text: Complete rows with falling pieces. The board and pieces are generated locally; their colours are game cues rather than measurements. Press Restart when you are ready to replace the current round.

await.hint: Press Restart in the game header.

steps.title: Read the controls
steps.text: Use Left/Right to move, Down to descend faster, Up to rotate and Space to drop. P pauses. Help describes the saved round, score and optional sound.

await.hint: Press Help in the game header.

steps.title: Check the fresh round
steps.text: Close Help, then press Restart once more. Check that the well is empty, the score is reset and a new piece is ready. The guide waits for your click; it never presses a control for you.

await.hint: Press Restart in the game header and inspect the reset round.
